_doc: Pipeline config used for the 240-excerpt validation experiment
All paths are RELATIVE to data_root. Set data_root to the location of
your local copy of the data tree (audio + tap CSVs + annotator beats).
The alignment.* and optimizer.* blocks record the main settings used in
the paper. Stage 4 reads its window and KDE settings from this file.
Other optimizer values come from matching Python constants and defaults

alignment._comment: KDE and cleaning settings selected from 24 combinations tested across 240 excerpts (composite = 0.30*AMLt + 0.25*recall + 0.15*F + 0.15*split_half + 0.10*(1-oct_err) + 0.05*(1-ibi_cv)).

optimizer._comment: Two-term grid score S = D_bar + 0.5*C with period-proportional matching tolerance 0.12*T + 20 ms (see optimization/run_pipeline.py). Constants were selected during pipeline development using validation-corpus diagnostics and the sensitivity analyses in supplementary_analyses/METHOD_PARAMETERS.md. They were then held fixed for every reported analysis and were not tuned per excerpt or against listener-rating outcomes.

click_dsp._comment: 1100 Hz 12 ms Hanning click, 0.9 amplitude, 35/65 music/click mix, 44.1 kHz mono. Identical DSP across all listening conditions.
